prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic still lifestyle portrait inspired by a gentle morning routine, preserving the pink cable-knit sweater, blue jeans, small black shoulder bag and soft apartment interior.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with long light-brown hair and straight bangs, natural skin texture and a calm relaxed expression. She wears a dusty-pink cable-knit sweater, high-waisted blue jeans, black sneakers and carries a small black shoulder bag with a chain strap.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 4:5 or 2:3 full-body portrait in a softly lit home entry or bedroom. The adult woman stands naturally with one hand near her hair and the other near the bag or waistband, with relaxed shoulders and an everyday ready-to-go posture. Include warm taupe curtains, a neutral sofa or bed, soft carpet and minimal home details.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm morning window light creates delicate highlights on the sweater, hair and bag with gentle shadows. Keep the atmosphere healing, cozy, quiet and lived-in, with no studio gloss.
prompt.technical_specs: 4:5 or 2:3 vertical lifestyle photograph, 50mm-equivalent perspective, natural depth of field, detailed cable-knit, denim and hair texture, soft warm color and realistic skin.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic gentle morning-routine lifestyle portrait of one original approved adult woman with long light-brown hair and straight bangs, natural skin texture and a calm relaxed expression. She wears a dusty-pink cable-knit sweater, high-waisted blue jeans, black sneakers and carries a small black shoulder bag with a chain strap. Use a vertical 4:5 or 2:3 full-body portrait in a softly lit home entry or bedroom; she stands naturally with one hand near her hair and the other near the bag or waistband, relaxed shoulders and an everyday ready-to-go posture. Include warm taupe curtains, a neutral sofa or bed, soft carpet and minimal home details. Use soft warm morning window light, delicate shadows, detailed knit, denim, hair and bag texture, realistic skin and gentle natural color.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, child, teen, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted anatomy, wardrobe malfunction, invented logos, unreadable added text
